channel.title: Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology News (GEN) – Bias and Credibility - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology News (GEN) – Bias and Credibility (genengnews.com)

item.title: Targeting Tunneling Nanotubes Reduces Spread of Mutant Huntington's Protein
item.description: Findings from preclinical studies could point to therapeutic strategies for Huntington’s disease, as well as other neurodegenerative disorders and potentially cancer.

item.title: LazySlide: Open Framework for Integrating Whole-Slide and Molecular Data
item.description: LazySlide is an open-source tool that uses AI to analyze large tissue images, linking visual patterns with molecular data.

item.title: Engineered Esophagus Rebuilds Missing Organ Segment in Pig Models
item.description: Results show that eight pigs that received transplanted tissue had functional muscle, nerves, and blood vessels at the six-month mark.

item.title: Novartis Acquires Pikavation for Up to $3B, Expanding Cancer Pipeline
item.description: Novartis has committed up to $3 billion—two-thirds of that upfront—toward acquiring Pikavation Therapeutics, a subsidiary of Synnovation Therapeutics that specializes in developing PI3Kα inhibitor programs designed to treat forms of cancer.

item.title: StockWatch: CytomX Shares Yo-Yo on Colorectal Cancer Data
item.description: CytomX Therapeutics shares yo-yoed this past week, surging on positive early clinical data for its colorectal cancer candidate, then retreating on investor questions about the data. Also, Eli Lilly shares survive a downgrade by HSBC to the equivalent of "sell."

item.title: Aging Mice Share Features of Brain Network Decline with Humans
item.description: fMRI was used to track aging in mice, finding brain network decline similar to humans.

item.title: Skin Regeneration Enabled by Embryonic Healing Mechanism in Mice
item.description: A new method can regenerate skin without scars by unblocking a healing mechanism that shuts off after birth.

item.title: HIV Remains Suppressed in Some Patients After Treatment Withdrawal
item.description: Findings identify genes that may represent possible new targets for a "block and lock" strategy for curing HIV.

item.title: Synthetic DNA Manufacturing Hub Set Up in Boston by Artis BioSolutions
item.description: Artis was founded to provide platforms and capabilities that drug developers require to bring next-generation medicines to patients.

item.title: Modified Lipid Nanoparticles Boost mRNA Vaccine Delivery to Lymph Nodes
item.description: Engineered LNPs bypassed the liver and homed to lymph nodes in mice, boosting mRNA delivery and maintaining immune responses.
